hero.heading: Good food deserves <highlight>another table.</highlight>
hero.intro: At closing time, bakeries, caterers and restaurants share the food they can't sell. Community kitchens nearby collect it and serve it the same evening.

story.heading: From the bin's edge to someone's plate, in one evening.

steps.title: The ovens cool. Forty loaves are left.
steps.body: Good bread, baked this morning. Tomorrow it can't be sold.

steps.title: One minute on a phone.
steps.body: The baker lists them: forty loaves, Yaba, collect by 8 PM.

steps.title: Three kitchens see it. Three hands go up.
steps.body: A community kitchen, a food bank and a shelter each ask for it.

steps.title: One yes. Two kind no's.
steps.body: The baker approves one. The others are told at once, so nobody makes a wasted trip.

steps.title: Dinner is served.
steps.body: The bread that was going to the bin is on the table, still soft.

story.note: An illustration of how FoodBridge works. The places are real; the evening is imagined.

foodBand.line: Nothing good should go to waste.

howItWorks.heading: Simple enough for the end of a long day.

steps.title: List it
steps.body: What it is, how much, where, and by when. A photo if you have one.

steps.title: They ask for it
steps.body: Community groups nearby find it by food, area and deadline, and request it.

steps.title: You choose one
steps.body: Approve one request; everyone else knows straight away. They collect before the deadline.

promise.heading: A promise you can plan around.
promise.body: Each listing goes to exactly one group, even when several ask in the same second. Food past its deadline can't be requested. Everyone always sees where they stand.

join.heading: Which side of the table are you on?

sides.title: Bakeries, caterers, restaurants
sides.body: Turn what's left at closing time into tonight's dinner for someone nearby. You decide who gets it.

sides.title: Community kitchens, food banks, shelters
sides.body: See good food close to you, ask for what you can collect, and know straight away where you stand.

closing.heading: Tonight, let nothing good <accent>go to waste.</accent>
